purpose: Executable fixed score-free baseline for a research-only long spot test; no activation authority.
mechanism_rationale: A completed-bar shock, unusual volume, and elevated trailing volatility are observable proxies for urgent selling. The thresholds are deliberately simple mechanism-linked starting values selected before any baseline outcome inspection; they are not optimized estimates of a profitable boundary.

data_contract.availability_rule: Every setup field must have availability_time <= decision_time. Missing, duplicated, irregular, or later rows fail closed.
data_contract.proxy_limit: Price and volume are proxies for forced selling; this baseline does not claim direct liquidation observations.

volatility.name: trailing_realized_volatility
volatility.annualization: none; sqrt(6) converts four-hour observations to a 24-hour proxy

execution.entry: First executable 1-minute child bar at or after the signal close; use that child bar open plus declared two-sided slippage. If the child bar is unavailable, stale, or a gap is detected, record an unresolved execution and fail the run; do not silently skip it.
execution.entry_price: child_open; TradeLifecycleV5 records the raw executable open and debits declared entry slippage separately.

stop.price: raw_entry_price * (1 - 0.06); entry slippage is a separate cost debit.
stop.adverse_executable_price: min(child_open, stop_price); TradeLifecycleV5 debits declared exit slippage separately.
stop.gap_rule: The child low triggers the stop, but the fill is the adverse executable child open when it gaps through the stop, otherwise stop_price, each with exit slippage. Child low is never itself a fill.
stop.engine_convention: The lifecycle engine never folds slippage into the stop anchor; it records fee and slippage cost rows independently.

timeout.exit: next executable child open after the horizon; if unavailable, fail closed

sizing.exchange_filters: physical decision-time Binance symbol filters are required; missing or changed filters fail closed
sizing.minimum_notional: decision-time exchange minimum; reject below it
sizing.rounding: round quantity down to the declared lot_step; never round up

overlap.per_asset: one_open_position; later qualifying events while open are recorded as skipped and never replace the open event
overlap.market_wide: events within 24 hours across assets share one episode_id and are treated as dependent

market_episode_clustering.episode_id: UTC floor of the earliest qualifying event in a 24-hour rolling cluster

controls.pool: same asset and venue, prior completed signal bars in the historical window with a pre-decision downside return in [-0.08, -0.02], no qualifying shock, and position state FLAT at the candidate decision time
controls.exclusion: exclude any candidate with data unavailable at decision time, any qualifying shock, any non-downside return, any future outcome field, or an event_time outside the prior 365 days. Candidate event_time + 240h must be <= treated event_time - 240h so scheduled lifecycles cannot overlap. Position state is the as-of decision snapshot, never a future outcome.
controls.tie_break: minimum standardized matching distance, then earliest event_time, then lexical episode_id
controls.execution_and_lifecycle: identical to the event, including child entry, stop-first collision, gap handling, timeout, fees, slippage, quantity rounding, and symbol filters. Resolve future child bars only after the control is selected; missing coverage is an explicit unresolved-control disposition.

falsifier.null: paired event-minus-control expectancy <= 0 or event expectancy <= 0 after costs
falsifier.bootstrap: seeded market-episode block bootstrap with shared draws across event and control pairs
falsifier.failure_disposition: ECONOMIC_FAILURE when inputs are valid and the frozen null is not rejected; INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when episode or trade minimums are unmet; INVALID_EVIDENCE when PIT/physical contracts fail; COMPUTE_INCOMPLETE when a declared budget ends before evaluation.
